title: Why do we need Tasks to run Keep?
body:

title: Keeps crashing on iPhone (even latest iOS)
body:
The enmity between Apple and Google must be intensifying...  Google keep just keeps crashing whenever launched. I think once the app hits a certain a size eg 9gb(?) , it becomes too fat to run.  I checked with Apple, says it's Google. I check with Google, Google says... nothing.  They continue to enjoy the sound of silence....

-----
My previous review:

 It's a decent app for storing notes with pictures, lists etc and you can access it via web. However it's not reliable if you need reminders because the reminder function doesn't make any notifications appear on your home screen (I.e. it DOESN'T work as advertised). I have written multiple times to Google about this. Seems they like the sound of silence cos I don't get any response... Will give it a little while more time before switching over to something reliable. iPhone's simple reminders do a much better job in this area. Google 0 , Apple 1
